name: Panta OEM Diagnostics Expansion 5
usage_note: Curated from OEM service material archived by NHTSA. Verify engine configuration and current OEM procedure before repair.

documents.title: Detroit SPN 1077 FMI 14 EPA10 high-pressure fuel leak diagnostic path
documents.summary: Detroit's EPA10 SPN 1077/FMI 14 troubleshooting procedure checks for external high-pressure fuel leaks at the pump, rail feed lines, rail, injector lines, rail-pressure sensor and pressure-limiting valve, then checks for fuel in engine oil. Later branches use the PLV flow test and high-pressure leak detection with individual injector rail capping. The procedure distinguishes injector leakage from high-pressure-pump or multiple-injector leakage using rail bleed-down behavior. Important service note: Detroit identifies the high-pressure rail feed lines and associated one-time-use hardware as replacement items when removed. Follow current Detroit procedures and required safety precautions.

documents.title: Detroit three-filter fuel system rough running or stalling diagnostic workflow
documents.authority: Detroit Diesel OEM symptom diagnostic procedure
documents.summary: Detroit's three-filter rough-running/stalling procedure begins by checking related rail-pressure and exhaust-temperature faults. With no directing fault, it evaluates EGR Delta-P voltage under specified conditions and uses a Delta-P disconnect response to identify restricted EGR venturi ports. It then uses the automatic Fuel System Integrity Check (FSIC) and compares actual versus desired rail pressure, including erratic or saw-tooth rail-pressure behavior. Diagnostic lesson: rough running on an applicable Detroit is not automatically an injector problem; fault hierarchy, EGR measurement and fuel-pressure behavior are part of the OEM decision tree.

documents.title: Detroit SPN 3480 FMI 16 high doser fuel-line pressure
documents.source: NHTSA archived Detroit Diesel troubleshooting manual 6SE568
documents.summary: Detroit identifies SPN 3480/FMI 16 as a condition where doser cut-off is commanded fully and compensation pressure remains above the specified threshold. The OEM path first checks for related SPN 4077/FMI 14, SPN 3480/FMI 14, SPN 3480/FMI 31 and other fuel-system faults and directs those faults to be repaired first. Diagnostic lesson: treat the complete fault set and fuel system as a hierarchy before replacing the doser or related aftertreatment fuel components.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 low-side fuel system pressure testing — E094 applicability
documents.authority: PACCAR OEM Engine Service Bulletin E094
documents.summary: PACCAR Engine Service Bulletin E094 documents an OEM low-side fuel-system pressure testing procedure for the MX-13. Use this bulletin as an applicability pointer: when diagnosing an MX-13 complaint involving low supply pressure, hard start/no start or power loss, verify the exact engine/chassis applicability and use the current PACCAR low-side fuel pressure test rather than condemning high-pressure components based only on symptoms. PACCAR service material may be proprietary; Panta stores only this high-level diagnostic lesson and does not reproduce the protected procedure.
